input.prompt: Using the reference image as the exact layout template: replace the placeholder heading text '[ Your Heading Goes Here ]' with the real heading text ONLY, no brackets, no square bracket characters at all: AGENT RECOMMENDS. HUMAN DECIDES. — render it in the same magenta color, same bold font style, same size and position between the two vertical accent bars, with NO '[' or ']' characters anywhere near it. Replace the placeholder line '[ Optional subheading or supporting line goes here ]' with the real subheading text ONLY, no brackets: Inside a hospital cost-governance workflow built with agentic AI — in the same gray color and size, with no bracket characters. Keep the 'EVOLVEX · INSIGHT' label, the light pink background, the evolvextechnologies.com footer text, and the evolvex logo in the bottom-right corner exactly as shown — do not alter, move, or duplicate them. Fill the large empty content panel in the middle with a clean split-layout infographic on a soft light background with a thin vertical divider down the center — the content panel must have NO dashed border and NO outline box around it, just the graphic floating directly on the card's background: left column headed 'THE AGENT' in cooler purple tones with three short rows each holding a small white line icon and label — 'Analyzes OR spend data' (magnifying glass icon), 'Flags cost variance' (flag icon), 'Drafts governance report' (document icon); right column headed 'THE HUMAN' in warm orange tones with three short rows — 'Reviews findings' (eye icon), 'Owns the decision' (person icon), 'Approves the change' (checkmark icon). The central divider is a thin gradient line from purple to orange with a small glowing dot at the midpoint where a tiny handoff arrow icon sits pointing left-to-right. Accents: orange #F1600A, magenta #EE2A7B, purple #6228D7, sparing gold #F9CE34. All text must be sharp, correctly spelled, and legible.
